title: Site Behavior Lab publication transparency log
description: Append-only hash chain over every published report. Each entry commits to its predecessor, so the head commits to the entire publication history. The chain proves order and integrity; it does not prove existence at a point in time unless a corresponding external anchor is present.

chainAlgorithm.description: Names the hash and the serialization together. It is part of every entry preimage, so changing either rule is a new algorithm identity rather than a silent redefinition.

head.description: The last entry digest, or null for an empty log.

anchors.description: External existence proofs over a chain head. Empty means no third-party witness exists yet, and therefore no claim about when the log existed may be made.

sequence.description: Position in publication order, which is the log's own append order rather than report-id order.

reportWireSha256.description: sha256 of the exact published report wire bytes.

publicDigest.description: Canonical (canon-v1) digest from the report's provenance sidecar.

entryDigest.description: sha256 over the canonical JSON of {chainAlgorithm, previousEntryDigest, sequence, reportId, reportWireSha256, publicDigest}, where previousEntryDigest is null only at sequence 0.

entryCount.description: Number of entries the witnessed head covers.

head.description: Must equal the chain head at exactly entryCount entries.

proof.description: Proof bytes, inline so the log stays self-contained and verifiable offline.
